You are auditing an ALREADY-COMPLETE pull request as part of a code review (not a build-in-progress step). This is PR #70 in the zimmermann-pwa repo, branch `feature/SFCC-91_pdp-ui-colour-swatches-variation-selection`, currently checked out at HEAD (commit 75135712e000ca8957c6a44106b05fe48d2bf61f). Base is `develop` at commit 269d5d40149b9947111dd87e78d37b92fccd4c99. Author: Jhoan Dela Cruz. Do not fix anything — find and report problems only, exactly as your role normally works, just applied to review instead of a build step.

## What the PR does

Implements Jira SFCC-91 "PDP UI — Colour Swatches & Variation Selection": a paginated colour-swatch radiogroup on the Product Detail Page, replacing/supplementing the base SFCC SwatchGroup for the `color` variation attribute only on the PDP (non-PDP callers — cart quick-add, wishlist, bonus-product — keep the base SwatchGroup untouched).

Jira SFCC-91 description (verbatim): "As a Shopper, I want to see all available colours for a product and be able to switch between them on the page, so that I can explore the full range of colour options before choosing which to buy... Swatches are driven by the index image — one product image per colour variation that is designated in SFCC BM as the representative swatch image. Most products do not have a wide range of colours... Dani confirmed max needed number of colours will likely be around 7."

Relevant Jira comment history: an AC about "new style code + full page reload on colour change" was explicitly REMOVED from this ticket's scope on 2026-08-12 and deferred to SFCC-708 (a separate, still-in-progress story about cross-linked swatches between DIFFERENT master products, which is NOT part of this PR and correctly absent from it — do not flag its absence as a gap).

Relevant PRD (.docs/prd/pdp.md §2, confirmed requirements):
- PRD-002: colour swatches sourced from the Product API, not AP21.
- PRD-004: "'Also available in' colour swatches; selecting a colour updates the page content and URL." Hover-to-preview swatch behaviour is explicitly OUT of scope for go-live (custom build, not OOTB) — do not flag its absence.
- PRD-062 (§14): "Gallery updates to display variant images when a colour swatch is selected, without a full page reload."

## Files changed (26 total, +1719/-64 net across the PR's commit history)

Core new component: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/index.tsx` (component), `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts` (co-located Chakra recipe, registered in `overrides/app/theme/components/index.ts` as `ZimmColourSwatches`), `index.test.tsx` (29 Vitest tests), `index.stories.tsx` (Storybook).

Integration: `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` (adds `colourVariants`/`selectedColourValue`/`onColourSelect` optional props; when `onColourSelect` is provided and `id === SFCC_COLOUR_ATTRIBUTE_ID` inside the `variationAttributes.map()` loop, renders `ZimmColourSwatch` instead of the base `SwatchGroup`+`Swatch`; omitting these props keeps every existing caller — cart, wishlist, bonus-product — byte-identical). `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` (owns `shopperSelectedColour` state, `handleColourSelect` which does `history.replace` to set `?color=` in the URL, and builds `colourVariants` from `productResponse.variationAttributes` + a `filterImageGroups` util to resolve each colour's swatch image). `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/partials/staticProductHeader.tsx` (has an `afterContent` prop, added by an earlier commit in this PR for an approach that was later replaced — verify whether anything still passes `afterContent` a real value anywhere in the app; my own read of the current `product-detail/index.tsx`'s `renderHeader` call shows it does NOT pass `afterContent` any more).

Also touched: `overrides/app/theme/foundation/colour.ts` and `overrides/app/theme/foundation/zimmTokens.ts` (both Tier 1 design-token files — added one new semantic alias, `icon.disabled: grey[200]` / `--zimm-color-icon-disabled`, for a disabled chevron colour), `scripts/generateRegistry.mjs` (+57/-4, a parser robustness fix for a component-registry generator unrelated to colour swatches per se — multi-line TS prop type normalisation, quote/comment-aware paren depth tracking) plus `scripts/generateRegistry.test.mjs` (new, 81 lines), translation files (`translations/*.json` and their compiled `overrides/app/static/translations/compiled/*.json` counterparts, ~15-36 lines each, adding `colour_swatches.*` keys), and `.claude/registry/*.md` (auto-generated, regenerated by the script above).

**Not in the final diff, despite the PR description still describing them:** `e2e/features/pdp/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.feature` and `e2e/tests/zimm/pdp/SFCC-91_pdp-colour-swatches.spec.js` were added by an earlier commit and then REMOVED by the final commit ("chore(e2e): remove SFCC-91 colour swatch E2E tests from this branch... E2E work preserved in a local stash"). The PR body was never updated to reflect this — treat the PR body's file table and "Test plan" E2E checklist as stale narrative, not ground truth; the diff and current file tree are ground truth.

## My own gate measurements (head vs. base — do NOT re-run these, just use them)

- `npx tsc --noEmit`: clean on head (0 errors).
- `npm run test`: 447/447 passing on head, 28 test files (includes the new 29 ZimmColourSwatch tests and 8 staticProductHeader tests).
- `npm run lint`: base (develop) has 20 problems (4 errors, 16 warnings), all 4 errors pre-existing in `overrides/app/routes.tsx` and `overrides/app/theme/components/recipeGuards.test.ts` (neither touched by this PR). Head has 23 problems (6 errors, 17 warnings) — the delta is CONFIRMED (via `git blame`) to be: 2 new prettier errors in `overrides/app/components/product-view/index.tsx` at (current head) lines 82 and 892, both auto-fixable with `--fix`; and 1 new warning ("Unused eslint-disable directive") at `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` line 270, on a `// eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps` comment above the `useEffect(() => { setShopperSelectedColour(urlColour) }, [urlColour, requestedProductId])` that syncs colour state with the URL — the effect doesn't actually need the suppression.
- `node scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs`: base has 4 unacknowledged raw-value violations, all pre-existing in `product-view/index.tsx` (120px×2, 32px, 200px). Head has 7 unacknowledged: this PR actually FIXED the 4 pre-existing ones (added `audit-allow: verbatim from base product-view...; copy-first requires it unchanged` comments while touching that file) but introduced 3 NEW ones — `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/index.tsx` lines 263-266, three raw px values (`width:'1px'`, `height:'1px'`, `margin:'-1px'`) inside the standard screen-reader-only visually-hidden inline style block used to keep off-page swatches in the accessibility tree. These are a well-known universal a11y idiom, not a design value, but the audit script has no exception for it and there's no `audit-allow` comment on it.

Please don't re-derive any of the above — spend your budget elsewhere.

## Angles to cover (dispatch your own sub-agents per your normal process)

1. **Correctness & regression** — focus especially on: (a) `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/index.tsx` line ~307, `selectedColour` derivation reads `productResponse?.variationValues?.color` as a bare string literal instead of the `SFCC_COLOUR_ATTRIBUTE_ID` constant that every other reference in the same file uses — confirm whether this is a real robustness gap (I've confirmed the line exists as described; assess severity/blast-radius, not existence). (b) The keyboard-navigation and pagination logic in `zimmColourSwatch/index.tsx` (`handleKeyDown`, the auto-advance `useEffect`s, `swatchVariantsRef`) — this went through several CodeRabbit-flagged bugs across the PR's commit history (wrong-swatch-selected-after-pagination, stale closure issues); verify the CURRENT head code is actually correct for: chevron-navigate to a page not containing the selected colour, then press ArrowRight/ArrowLeft from a swatch on that new page — does it move from the FOCUSED swatch or incorrectly from the SELECTED one? Also verify wrap-around at both ends, and the zero-selection initial state. (c) The edge case where a product has a `color` variation attribute with values, but EVERY value fails the internal AC5 filter (no resolved swatch image, or `orderable: false`) — trace what actually renders in that case (I read the component and believe it shows a bare "Colour:" label with nothing after it, since `ProductView`'s gate only checks the raw unfiltered `colourVariants.length`, not the post-filter count) — confirm or correct this. (d) Whether colour selection (`handleColourSelect` → `history.replace` with `?color=`) actually causes the product image GALLERY to update to the new colour's photos without a full reload (PRD-062) — trace the mechanism through `useDerivedProduct`/`usePDPSearchParams` (base SFCC hooks, not overridden) rather than assuming; flag if you find a reason it would NOT work, or if you cannot conclusively determine it from source alone (that's a legitimate "needs browser verification" answer — I will verify this myself live).

2. **Conventions, structure, tier ownership** — check against `.claude/rules/conventions.md`, `components.md`, `overrideStyling.md`, `css.md`, and `.claude/rules/frozenFiles.md` / `protectedFiles.md`. In particular: is the new component's location (`ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/`) and co-located `.css.ts` recipe pattern consistent with how the rest of the codebase does this (compare against `overrides/app/components/footer/footer.css.ts` and `ui-kits/atoms/zimmButton/zimmButton.css.ts` as reference implementations)? Does the component avoid data-fetching (container/presentational separation — it should receive `variants`/`selectedValue`/`onSelect` as props only)? Any magic numbers/strings that should be named constants? Is `overrides/app/pages/product-detail/partials/staticProductHeader.tsx`'s `afterContent` prop and its dedicated test block (`staticProductHeader.test.tsx`, "afterContent branch (SFCC-91)") now dead code given nothing in the current head passes `afterContent` a real value anymore — confirm by grepping the whole `overrides/` tree for `afterContent` usage, don't assume.

3. **Contract fidelity (SFCC bridge pattern)** — `product-view/index.tsx` is a copy-first port whose default export must stay byte-identical for existing callers per `.claude/rules/overrideStyling.md`'s "SFCC bridge pattern" section. Verify: with `onColourSelect` omitted (the case for `product-view-modal`, `bonus-product-view-modal`), does every code path through the `variationAttributes.map()` block behave EXACTLY as the pre-PR base file did? Look specifically at whether the new `if (id === SFCC_COLOUR_ATTRIBUTE_ID && onColourSelect)` branch could ever be entered unintentionally, and whether the surrounding closure/scoping of the map callback was changed in any way that affects the non-colour-swatch (size, etc.) rendering path for ALL callers, not just PDP.

4. **Failure modes & security** — `filterImageGroups` (in `product-detail/index.tsx`, sourced from `@salesforce/retail-react-app/app/utils/product-utils` per the current import — verify this import path is correct and not importing a deleted/moved project-owned utility; earlier PR commits show this util was moved around several times, including a "Remove duplicate filterImageGroups utility; use public export from product-utils" commit). What happens if `productResponse.imageGroups` is malformed or a colour value has no matching image group at all — does anything throw, or does it degrade gracefully to `imageUrl: undefined` (which the AC5 filter should then exclude)? Any risk from rendering colour `displayName`/`name` values without sanitisation (these come from the Commerce API, not raw user input, so likely low risk, but confirm no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML` or similar is involved).

5. **Token & styling strategy** — beyond the audit-script findings I already gave you, manually review `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts` for hierarchy compliance per `overrideStyling.md` (var(--zimm-*) usage, no bare Chakra token keys, `textStyle` for type). Check whether the `--zimm-color-icon-disabled` token added to the two Tier 1 foundation files is a correctly-derived alias (reads from an existing primitive, doesn't invent a new hex) — I've already confirmed it reads `grey[200]`, an existing primitive, so don't re-verify that part; instead assess whether a disabled-icon-colour semantic token was really missing from the design system before this (i.e. is this a legitimate net-new addition to the system, or should an existing token have covered this already, suggesting a naming/discoverability gap rather than a true gap).

Report your findings the way you normally do. I will independently verify every finding before deciding what's blocking.

/**
 * Recipe guards — regression tests for four failure modes that reached a feature branch
 * despite passing `tsc`, `eslint`, `vitest`, CodeRabbit and the Storybook a11y run.
 *
 * All four share a shape: the value is a *valid* `SystemStyleObject` entry, so TypeScript is
 * satisfied; no lint rule covers it; and nothing asserts layout. Each one renders plausible,
 * wrong output that is only visible by opening the page.

 *      through `theme.sizes`, not `theme.space`. The Zimmermann named scale is registered as
 *      `space` only (deliberately — see foundation/sizes.ts), so `width: 'xl'` silently reads
 *      Chakra's default `sizes.xl` = 36rem. It shipped a 576px icon and collapsed the footer.

 *      deliberately NOT registered either (theme/index.ts explains why), so a bare key reads
 *      Chakra's default or resolves to nothing at all. See TYPOGRAPHY_PROPS below.
